description: Every eval class that does not need a MOTION.md staged. One exemplar rule per class from TAXONOMY.md, so each harness shape is proven before the remaining rules are filled in behind it.

evals.title: B · T-001 detection with no motion language
evals.prompt: Review the motion in this screen. File: fixtures/AppNavigation.kt

negatives.note: Correct gesture-driven Animatable with velocity carried into animateDecay.
Spec resolves to the scheme, animated value read in a graphicsLayer lambda.

expectations: Flags the NavHost as inheriting the 700ms default
Reports it as minor — nothing has been decided here for it to contradict
Does NOT flag DismissibleCard or StatusBanner

evals.title: B · T-001 precision, transitions specified
evals.prompt: Review the motion in this screen. File: fixtures/AppNavigation.kt

negatives.note: All four transitions bound to product tokens. The compliant form.
Gesture handling and banner fade, both correct.

expectations: Produces no T-001 finding
Does not object to the cross-fade itself — unordered top-level destinations cross-fade correctly under T-011

evals.title: A · F-001 static twin, one line apart
evals.prompt: Review the motion in this component. File: fixtures/FilterBar.kt

negatives.note: FilterSummary animates the identical value through offset { } — the lambda form, read in layout. This is the fix, sitting fourteen lines below the defect.
FilterCount reads its animated alpha in graphicsLayer and its colour in drawBehind. Both correct.

expectations: Flags FilterHandle's Modifier.offset(x = slide) as reading a frame-rate value during composition
Does NOT flag FilterSummary, which animates the same value correctly through offset { }
Does NOT flag FilterCount's graphicsLayer or drawBehind reads
Names offset { IntOffset(...) } as the fix, not 'use a lambda' generically

evals.title: C · O-002 absence, with a twin that is legitimately exempt
evals.prompt: Review the motion in this screen. Files: fixtures/SyncStatus.kt, fixtures/sync_complete.json

negatives.note: NoResults is decorative and the Text below carries the message, so the illustration losing its motion costs nothing. O-001's static carrier is the Text.

expectations: Notices sync_complete.json has no marker named 'reduced motion' among its markers
Connects that to the outro at frame 120-150 fading the tick to zero opacity, so the last frame — where Lottie seeks when animations are off — is empty
Identifies SyncComplete as the problem because the illustration is the ONLY confirmation the user gets
Does NOT demand a marker on NoResults, where the text carries the meaning
Does not confuse the Lottie marker with the Android 'Remove animations' setting

evals.title: D · T-009 asks rather than asserts
evals.class: D. Not in the source at all
evals.prompt: Review the motion in this component. File: fixtures/RatingControl.kt
expectations: Recognises that whether this exceeds the frequency ceiling depends on how often users rate books, which is not in the source
ASKS how often this is used, or states the assumption it is reasoning from, rather than asserting a verdict
If it does raise T-009, it scopes the claim — 'if this is a high-frequency surface, then…' — rather than declaring a violation
Does NOT assert a usage frequency it cannot know
Does NOT flag the spring itself: fastSpatialSpec on a rare, deliberate interaction is correct

evals.title: E · T-026 composite defect, every part correct
evals.prompt: Review the motion in this screen. File: fixtures/CheckoutSummary.kt

negatives.note: TotalRow: token spec, lambda offset. Individually correct.
SavingsBadge: AnimatedVisibility, effects tier, faster exit than enter. Individually correct.
PostageNote: token spec, lambda offset. Individually correct.
LoyaltyPoints: effects spec, graphicsLayer read. Individually correct.
CheckoutButton: spatial spec, graphicsLayer read. Individually correct.

expectations: Identifies that five elements animate on one event and none of them leads
Reports it against the screen or CheckoutSummary itself, not against any individual composable
Does NOT report the five children as five separate findings — every one of them is individually correct
Suggests choosing what the event is about, rather than tuning any single spec

evals.title: F · F-006 legitimate twin, same construct both ways
evals.prompt: Review the motion in this file. File: fixtures/ExpandableRow.kt

negatives.note: CollapsibleBlurb clips deliberately — the cut-off line is the affordance saying there is more. clipToBounds is explicit and heightIn caps it. Asserting a defect here is the failure this case exists to catch.

expectations: Flags BookRow, where shadow(6.dp) sits directly above animateContentSize and will have its shadow cut
Does NOT assert a defect on CollapsibleBlurb, where clipping is explicit and intended
If it mentions CollapsibleBlurb at all, it asks whether the clipping is intended rather than declaring it wrong
Distinguishes the two by the surrounding signal — an elevated container versus an explicit clipToBounds with a height cap

evals.title: G · T-008 framework-correct, precision only
evals.prompt: Review the back handling and motion in this screen. File: fixtures/ReaderScreen.kt

negatives.note: NavHost already installs its own predictive-back handler and seeks with SeekableTransitionState. Zero app code is required, and flagging it is the failure this case exists to catch.

expectations: Does NOT flag the NavHost — the framework already seeks predictive back correctly
Flags the BackHandler closing the notes panel, which fires on commit and cannot follow the finger
Names PredictiveBackHandler with a seekable progress value as the fix
Scopes the finding to the hand-rolled panel, not to back handling in general
